background: Barclays Bank UK PLC is the ring-fenced retail bank of Barclays, funded by UK personal and small-business deposits and lending on residential mortgages, cards and to smaller companies.
synthesis: Ratings are strong at A+ on average across all three main agencies, all three on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios are the best of the Barclays entities: CET1 of 13.8% is at the UK-major median, leverage of 5.0% is just above the peer median, and LCR of 168% and NSFR of 152% are both in the top quarter. The direction is down, though: since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.7 points, leverage 0.5 points and LCR 33 points, so a large liquidity surplus is being run off. Nothing flagged in the last 90 days.
